status-bot: :warning: Alert: spike in 5xx (502/504) and gateway timeouts observed on inference-gateway-prod. Error ratio >7% across regions. Paging oncall.

jen.park: I see the surge started around 3080001280. Dashboards show a big jump in prefix cache evictions and downstream origin latency.

nina.k: Oncall here. Jumping in. Any signs of traffic surge or deploys?

rafael: No recent deploys. Telemetry: prefix cache miss -> prefetch fanout increased ~8x. Also seeing `rdb-checksum-fail` metric for prefix-shard-21.

jen.park: Logs (trimmed):```
[3080001291] shard=21 event=rdb_checksum_failed key=prefix:usr:42
[3080001292] shard=21 event=evict_batch size=1800 reason=corruption_detected
[3080001293] gateway id=gw-7 response=504 origin_latency=1350ms
```

nina.k: That explains the origin storms. Short-term plan: 1) turn off eager prefetching 2) stop prefix writes to shard group until we stabilize 3) promote healthy replica for impacted shard 21.

jen.park: Agreed. I'll flip the prefetch flag (it's `cache.eager_prefetch.enabled` in config service).

ops-bot: config-service: change request received. Applying `cache.eager_prefetch.enabled=false` to prod.

deploy-bot: change applied, rolling config push to inference-gateway-prod.

rafael: Also, reduce readthrough pressure by enabling a temporary KV-bypass lane for 10% of traffic to avoid origin overload:```
./opsctl route update inference-gateway --add-bypass=10 --reason="eviction mitigation"
```

deploy-bot: traffic update done. 10% of requests now using kv-bypass.

jen.park: Observability: within 45s of these changes, prefetch requests dropped 95% and eviction rate fell ~60%. Overall 5xx rate dropping but still higher for some tenants.

nina.k: Running rdb check on shard21 node:```
$ redis-cli -h shard21-01 INFO server
# RDB: last-save-time=...
$ redis-check-rdb /var/lib/redis/dump.rdb
*** RDB checksum mismatch at 0x5A7C4
```

rafael: Replica 21b looks consistent and behind ~18s. Plan: promote 21b -> primary and rebuild 21-01 as follower (full resync). Also pause prefix writes: set `prefix.write.enabled=false`.

jen.park: I'll apply the write-block and then trigger promotion.```
# block writes
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS" https://config-api/prod -d '{"prefix.write.enabled":false}'
# promote
opsctl shard promote --shard=21 --to=21b
```

deploy-bot: prefix write flag applied. opsctl: promotion started; ETA ~25s.

ops-bot: promotion finished: shard21 primary -> 21b. Old primary marked for full sync.

rafael: After promotion and flags, 5xx down to ~2% over last 5m. Latency stabilizing. Still tracking a handful of customers with elevated errors (glossy-inc and marketlytics).

samir: CS indicates both customers reported intermittent timeouts starting at the alert. I'll surface notes to their account reps and post an update to status page.

status-bot: Draft status: "We are investigating increased latency and 5xx errors caused by a corrupted prefix cache shard that triggered an eviction/fanout spike. Immediate mitigations applied: eager prefetch disabled, affected shard promoted to healthy replica, prefix writes paused, and a temporary KV bypass activated. Monitoring continues." Publish? (y/n)

samir: Publish now. I'll follow up with targeted customer updates.

nina.k: Next steps: schedule a low-rate checksum sweep across prefix shards to verify integrity; add an automated circuit-breaker to disable prefetch if per-shard eviction rate >300/s; improve alerting to include `rdb_checksum_failed` as a pager condition; and add a runbook for automatic replica promotion when checksum fails. I'll create tickets.

jen.park: Can someone also add a short-term metric to auto-throttle prefetch if origin 5xx > 1% for >2m? That would've helped earlier.

rafael: Will add alert rule and a temporary throttler. Also capturing log snippets and heap profiles for an RCA.

nina.k: Handing active paging to infra-oncall for follow-up. I'll monitor for the next 45m then transition to RCA owner.

samir: Status page updated and customer emails sent. Severity set to Sev2.

jen.park: Good work. Closing pager for now but leaving thread open for RCA artifacts and tickets. :white_check_mark:
